why: Computes the clamp and then ignores it, keeping the stranded id in the config while STILL rendering the notice -- the pane says the board was replaced and launches the board it said it replaced. A pure-function test on retainArenaChoice cannot see this and neither can a notice-presence assertion; only the hud case's launch-gate assertion on the emitted config catches it, which is why that assertion runs resolveVersusConfig rather than reading versusConfigState.
